primary_metric: official binary task reward, operational (condition-owned failures counted as 0)

document.purpose: Paired, pre-registered pilot of ReasonProxy deliberation against the same frozen controller run natively, under the official DeepSWE harness. Exploratory: this is not a benchmark score and not a frontier comparison.

dataset.name: DeepSWE v1.1
dataset.selection_rule: Per language, sort the reservation-filtered task ids lexicographically, shuffle with random.Random(0), take quota {typescript: 3, go: 3, python: 3, javascript: 1}. Sorted input makes the draw independent of filesystem dirent order, unlike Pier's own --sample-seed path (DatasetConfig._filter_task_ids shuffles Path.iterdir() output).
dataset.selection_note: The authoritative artifact is the explicit task_names list below. The seed is provenance only; it is not replayed at run time.

reserved_tasks.ytt-jsonpath-query-api: conformance/dev task. Oracle-verified (reward 1, f2p 103/103, p2p 1/1) as infrastructure proof. Excluded from every pilot metric; usable only via `run --conformance`.

document.pre_outcome_axes_note: All 113 DeepSWE tasks declare identical cpus/memory/storage/timeouts/network/verifier mode, so no resource-based stratification exists. Any resource-based filter would be post-hoc.

conditions.arm: native-default serial baseline: no tool injection, no interception
treatment: private zero-arg reason tool, 4 branches + reducer
no-op arm: identical advertised prompt/tool, fixed neutral result, no workers

contrasts.reads: effect of live deliberation over the same frozen controller run natively
effect of deliberation content, holding the injected prompt/tool surface constant
effect of the injected prompt/tool surface alone (schema perturbation control)

execution_order.rationale: Modes are adjacent within a task so any truncated execution still yields complete paired triples. cf-super runs last because its Cloudflare credential window is the shortest; a credential refresh must not straddle a family.
execution_order.subset_rule: Subsets must be a prefix of this fixed order or an explicit condition/task/repeat filter named before execution. Outcome-dependent staging, adaptive repeats and early stopping are prohibited.

primary_metric.name: official binary task reward, operational (condition-owned failures counted as 0)
primary_metric.produced_by: unmodified DeepSWE separate pristine verifier (verifier.environment_mode=separate, network_mode=no-network, timeout_sec=1800)
primary_metric.aggregation_over_repeats: mean of per-trial values per task per condition
primary_metric.zero_credit_for: agent timeout, nonzero agent exit (including private-tool protocol exhaustion), provider/proxy transport failure - see outcome_adjudication
primary_metric.excluded: host/container/verifier-side infrastructure failures and unexecuted trials, both reported with counts
tests: exact McNemar (paired, two-sided) when every paired value is 0 or 1
exact sign-flip permutation on the paired mean difference (Monte Carlo with fixed seed above 20 paired tasks)
seeded paired percentile bootstrap CI over tasks

secondary_metrics.name: f2p
secondary_metrics.note: continuous, higher power than binary, reported as secondary only

secondary_metrics.name: proxy deliberation telemetry
secondary_metrics.source: ReasonProxy trace JSONL joined by virtual_model and agent-execution time window

harness.mini_swe_agent_pin_mechanism: Pier agent kwarg `version` -> `uv tool install mini-swe-agent==2.4.6` inside the sandbox
harness.model_adapter_note: The hosted_vllm/ prefix keeps mini-swe's LitellmModel and therefore native function calling (BASH_TOOL). An openai/ prefix would select the Responses adapter and is prohibited.
harness.allowlist_derivation: Pier reads model.model_kwargs.api_base out of the mini-swe config_yaml (agents/network.py collect_url_values -> allowlist_from_urls), promoting the agent phase from no-network to a hostname-only allowlist. The verifier phase stays no-network.
harness.cost_limit: disabled: mini-swe agent.cost_limit=0 plus MSWEA_COST_TRACKING=ignore_errors (free endpoints report cost 0.0, which would otherwise raise)
harness.n_concurrent_rationale: The Docker VM has ~7.65 GiB total while every DeepSWE task declares memory_mb 8192; concurrent trials would risk OOM kills scored as task failures.
harness.harness_modifications: none; Pier and mini-swe-agent are used as installed

outcome_adjudication.graded: the official verifier produced rewards -> use the reported values verbatim. A graded reward of 0 is a failure of the condition, whatever the proxy did internally: degraded deliberation, an unvalidated checkpoint or a skipped reason call never converts a graded 0 into an exclusion.

operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.AgentTimeoutError: the agent exceeded the official agent timeout
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.NonZeroAgentExitCodeError: mini-swe-agent exited nonzero, including RepeatedFormatError from a malformed or leaked private tool call
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.ApiError: provider or proxy transport failure surfaced to the agent
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.ApiRateLimitError: rate limiting, which a K-way fan-out can itself cause
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.ApiUsageLimitError: usage limit reached during the trial
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.ApiConnectionError: connection failure to the proxy endpoint
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.ApiResponseStalledError: response stalled past the adapter's patience
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.ApiProviderResourceNotFoundError: provider resource missing at call time
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.AgentAuthenticationError: the sandbox could not authenticate to the proxy
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.ModelNotFoundError: the proxy did not serve the requested alias
operational_failure_counted_as_reward_0.ContextWindowExceededError: context exhausted, which deliberation persistence can itself cause

outcome_adjudication.operational_failure_rationale: These are outcomes of the system under test - controller, proxy, fan-out, persistence, endpoint - not of the host. Excluding them would flatter whichever arm fails most often, so they carry zero credit in the primary metric and are additionally reported by category.
outcome_adjudication.infrastructure_rationale: Host, container and verifier-side failures are not attributable to any condition; they are excluded from both metrics, counted, and listed per trial for adjudication.
outcome_adjudication.unclassified: any other exception: reported explicitly, excluded from both metrics, never zero-filled
outcome_adjudication.missing_or_unexecuted: reported as missing against requested/planned/executed counts. Missing is not a zero.
outcome_adjudication.no_synthesis: Missing trial scores are never imputed, averaged in, or replaced by another condition's value.

operational.definition: graded binary reward, with operational failures counted as 0; infrastructure failures and missing trials excluded and listed
operational.reads: end-to-end probability that this condition solves a task through this harness

graded_only.definition: binary reward over trials that reached the verifier, with no imputation
graded_only.reads: descriptive accuracy conditional on completing a trial; it is not an effect estimate and its denominator differs between arms

analysis_rules.pairing: a task enters a contrast only when both arms have a usable value for that metric
analysis_rules.coverage_reporting: planned, requested, executed, graded, operational-failure and infrastructure-excluded counts are reported per condition, always alongside any metric
analysis_rules.conditional_subsets: Subsets conditioned on outcomes or on whether the controller invoked reason are descriptive only and may never be presented as a causal effect.
analysis_rules.power: 10 tasks x 1 trial cannot detect any plausible effect size; simulated power for paired binary designs at this n is ~0. The pilot is declared underpowered and exploratory. Binary reward remains the declared primary metric.
analysis_rules.floor_risk: If the baseline arm scores 0 on every task, the paired binary contrast is uninformative by construction; report that fact rather than an effect.
prohibited_claims: any frontier comparison, gap-closing percentage, or shared-axis plot with published leaderboard values
any causal uplift claim beyond the executed paired contrast
any statement that substitutes the public DeepSWE leaderboard for an unexecuted baseline
any 'state of the art' or 'matches/approaches frontier' phrasing
any headline metric that drops the treatment arm's own protocol, quorum or timeout failures

authorization.paid_frontier_baseline: BLOCKED - not authorized, not run, and not substituted with public leaderboard values
authorization.executed_model_set: free OpenCode Zen aliases and Cloudflare Workers AI only

credentials.policy: Provider credentials stay on the host in the ReasonProxy process only. Task, agent and verifier environments receive no provider credential.
credentials.sandbox_credential: a single local proxy bearer token, injected as a ${ENV} template that the harness resolves at runtime; never written into a job config, config_yaml, manifest or argv

replication.status: exploratory paired replication subset on an independent benchmark and harness; not a Terminal-Bench score
replication.note: Frozen by the same rule family before model outcomes; reserved dev task cancel-async-tasks is grader conformance only.

mini_swe_agent_in_sandbox.pin_mechanism: agent kwarg `version` -> uv tool install mini-swe-agent==<version> inside the sandbox

roster.credential_note: Provider credentials live only in the host proxy process; only variable names are recorded here.

sources.note: No git commit exists for this working tree; these are content hashes.

host.emulation_note: DeepSWE images are linux/amd64; on an arm64 host they execute under emulation, which consumes part of the official agent budget.
